200.description:
The text of one provision or structural division of an Act or instrument from its CLML `data.xml`: `provision` is the site's path such as `section/14`, `article/3`, `regulation/2`, `part/3`, `chapter/2`, `schedule/6` or `schedule/6/paragraph/1`. Returns document metadata, the division's heading, every section-level provision (`P1`) inside it with its number, heading, identifier URI and plain text (sub-provisions numbered `(1)`, `(a)`), the in-force and extent restrictions, the list of other versions the site holds, and any changes the editorial team has not yet applied (`unapplied_effects`, so you know when the text lags). `version` selects `enacted`/`made`, `prospective` or a `YYYY-MM-DD` point-in-time text; the default is the current text.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `provisions` as the primary payload key.

| `number` | string |  |
| `start_date` | string |  |

200.description:
Resolve a legislation title (optionally narrowed by type, year and number) to its identifier through `/id?title=...`. A unique match is a 301 to `/id/{type}/{year}/{number}` and returns `resolved: true` with that identifier; an ambiguous title is the site's 300 Multiple Choices page and returns `resolved: false` with every candidate (identifier, title). A title the site knows nothing about is `not_found`. Uncached lookups can take several seconds.

200.description:
Search or list UK legislation as the site's Atom feed (`/{type}[/{year}]/data.feed`): title words, full-text words, a legislation type or family (`ukpga`, `uksi`, `asp`, ..., or `all`, `primary`, `secondary`, `primary+secondary`) and a year, 20 results per page. Each result carries the identifier URI (`/id/{type}/{year}/{number}`), type, year, number, title, long-title summary, subject categories, dates and the URLs of its contents and XML.
